stem:
Meena makes an electromagnet by winding an insulated copper wire around an iron nail and connecting the wire to a cell. When she brings the north pole of a magnetic compass near end X of the nail, the compass needle's north pole is attracted towards end X.
What are the polarities of the two ends of the electromagnet?

options.text: end X is North and end Y is South
end X is South and end Y is North
both end X and end Y are North
both end X and end Y are South

teacher.key_rationale: Unlike poles attract, so if the compass's north pole is attracted to end X, end X must be the South pole; the other end Y is therefore North. Option A is the trap for students who assume the attracted end has the same polarity as the compass pole.
